maria: Quick check — PR #17822 is green locally but CI is stuck on integration for >2 hours. We have the weekend deploy blackout starting Sun 00:00 UTC. Can we get eyes so we don't miss the window? :eyes:
kevin: On it, will try a targeted rerun for the failing job. which job is flaky?
sam: infra flagged the DB-migration toggle in the PR, needs one more approval from platform for schema change. that could block landing even if CI passes. @kevin can you ping infra?
maria: failing job is `integration-e2e` on macos matrix. logs show a timeout in setup: ``TimeoutError: setup exceeded 10m`` — looks flaky not test-broken.
deploy-bot: CI update for PR #17822 — integration-e2e: failed (macos) — https://ci.example.com/17822/job/3421 
kevin: rebase would also bump the cache, might help. i'll do a small rebase to pick up infra's cache bump. also triggering targeted rerun: `/ci rerun --pr=17822 --jobs=integration-e2e.macos`
olivia: quick thought — if we don't get infra OK before blackout, do we want to hold this until Monday? I'd rather avoid a rollback during blackout.
maria: agree with caution. but if kevin's rerun passes and infra approves small toggle change, we could still land tonight before blackout.
kevin: pinged infra in #eng-infra thread, cc @sam. also kicked the rerun — ETA ~8m.
sam: got the ping, checking the migration diff now. if it's a small non-destructive flag we can approve and document the rollback plan.
maria: thanks — if the rerun passes i'll post the final merge ack here and add the rollback snippet to the PR description.
kevin: rerun passed on macos. integration-e2e ✅
maria: awesome. sam — any objection to approving the toggle?
sam: looks safe, approving in the review now.
maria: merging in 5 after a quick CI smoke. will hold if anything else flakes. :thumbsup:
kevin: noted, i'll watch the queue and abort if the deploy blackout window would be violated.
olivia: thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.
